purpose: The hash of each wiki page as last checked against the source PDFs by an independent reader (python -m wiki_api.content_review). The wiki doctor fails when a page differs from its entry. Methods: model (a fresh model call reviewed the changed lines; waived findings are listed with the reason), metadata-only (only front matter that makes no source claim changed), adopted (recorded without a model review; reason required). A review is a second reader, not proof that the page is right.
